title: spec(types): `ObjectChartSchema.chartType` declares 8 chart families on both faces while the installed spec's `ChartTypeSchema` declares more and plugin-charts draws them; align the face to the spec (preparation for objectui#11466)
body:
This card carries objectui#11466's report Q1 (object-chart half). It is a child of objectui#11466, filed with its `domain:spec` and `priority:p2`. objectui#11466 (V1, PR #11512) is `pm:blocked` until this card and its siblings land.

Filing-gate category: ① a contract gap with a named landing point and a measured reach.
- **Reach, measured by objectui#11466's dev** (report `5962392382`, `open_questions[0]`):
  - the dashboard's object-chart producer emits families the face does not declare (`funnel`, `treemap`, `sankey`, `combo` and `radar` among them);
  - plugin-charts draws them;
  - under V1 the producer cannot name `ObjectChartSchema` with no cast, so V1 cannot land.
- **Reader:** the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (objectui#10217) dispatches it, and an os-dev executes it.

## What the seat read (objectui `origin/main`, objectstack `main` `535d1d25`)

- **TS face:** `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` (about `:5301`) declares `chartType?: 'bar' | 'column' | 'horizontal-bar' | 'line' | 'area' | 'pie' | 'donut' | 'scatter';`, with the zod mirror in `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`.
- **The spec:** `packages/spec/src/ui/chart.zod.ts`'s `ChartTypeSchema` on objectstack `main` lists bar, horizontal-bar, column, line, area, pie, donut, funnel, scatter, treemap, sankey, combo, gauge, solid-gauge, metric, kpi and more. ⛔ The installed version (`@objectstack/spec` ^17.5.0 / 17.6.0) is the one that binds. The claim re-reads it.

## Seat ruling: A (non-escalation; governing text cited)

**Governing text:** the pm-dispatch skill's 〈升级与决策〉, 「协议为基准:spec 与代码不一致默认改代码对齐」, and its 基本裁决原则, 「spec 声明 > 实现 > 文档面」.

- `ObjectChartSchema.chartType` declares the installed spec's chart families that plugin-charts draws, on both faces, by reference to the spec's `ChartTypeSchema` where the sets coincide.
- **Measure first:** for each spec family, does plugin-charts draw it, measured through the real renderer with a control?
  - A spec family plugin-charts does not draw stays undeclared, and is reported as a finding with its family name. ⛔ No declaration of a family nothing draws.
- **Rejected options:**
  - B (keep the face at 8, and have the dashboard map or refuse) drops spec-legal families.
  - C (a second chart node) forks the contract.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is stated at claim.

## Constraints

- Every edit compiles on `main` today, and under objectui#11466's V1 candidate. PR #11512's branch is the probe; ⛔ never commit from it.
- **Pins:**
  - each newly declared family parses on both faces and renders through plugin-charts;
  - an undeclared spelling is refused with the set named;
  - the spec-reference identity is pinned where it is by reference.
- Pending `.changeset` entries this makes false get dated, append-only notes.

## Dedupe

The 800 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed, back to 2026-09-27 (REST, grepped locally 2026-10-02):
- `chartType` near funnel / treemap / sankey / radar / combo: 2 hits, PR #11512 (this card's source) and objectui#11457 (closed; it retired the per-family chart nodes);
- `ObjectChartSchema … chartType`: objectui#10770 and objectui#10802 (closed; the required flag).
